capability.description: Runs NCBI E-utilities esearch with db=pubmed, retmode=json, and retmax=5 for one required search term. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Biomedical literature discovery; not full-text retrieval, clinical diagnosis, or evidence appraisal.

constraint.io_signature: Input: term at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and PubMed JSON result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one PubMed ESearch query term or expression
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi with db=pubmed, retmode=json, retmax=5
no caller control for database, return mode, page size, pagination, or sort
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse the returned JSON
no authentication, cache, retry, or full article text

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing PubMed ESearch metadata, up to five IDs, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: diagnose a patient or give medical advice
